prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1353; do not mention it.)
text:
We write regarding our client, [CLIENT_NAME], who was seriously injured in a motor vehicle collision on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was traveling in the right lane when the at-fault driver, who was changing lanes without signaling or checking their blind spot, moved into our client's vehicle and sideswiped it. The impact forced our client's vehicle toward the guardrail and caused the driver's side to strike the barrier.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a concussion with persistent headaches, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Our client's treating physician has restricted work and driving while recovery continues, and our client has missed substantial time from employment. Ongoing treatment, including neurological follow-up and physical therapy, is expected to continue for the foreseeable future.

The police report documents the insured driver's admission that they did not see our client's vehicle before changing lanes. Liability is clear, and the insured's negligence is the sole cause of our client's injuries.

We are prepared to resolve this claim without litigation. Our client will accept [DEMAND_AMOUNT] in full settlement of all claims arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
